name: Spicy-Tart Kale Limeade

instructions.primary_message: Mix kale juice, ginger juice, and apple juice with coconut water. Serve in tall glasses. Garnish with lime slice if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: juice, kale, kale drinks, zero proof

description: Ginger adds heat to this tart kale limeade. Apple juice and coconut water tame the intense flavor—think of this as green juice for beginners—it's friendly, fun, and a little (naturally) sweet.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Garnish: lime slices

Notes: This recipe yields about 3 cups of juice, enough for two 1 1/2-cup servings.
In our testing, it took about 1 1/2 pounds of kale to produce 1 cup of juice. Results may vary based on kale and on juicer.

Make-ahead and storage: Juice is best served immediately and will lost flavor and color with time. Store leftover juice in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 1 day.
author: Maggie Hoffman
